objective: Measure whether a frozen OpenEvo WebShop route beats a matched SEED baseline in at least one prespecified dimension: score, win rate, speed, or execution quality.
scientific_question: Under one frozen WebShop task/seed/model/evaluator contract, does OpenEvo outperform SEED on any preregistered metric without hiding invalid attempts?

route_decision.qwen25_3b_gate: H1.30 v2 and fresh v3 train-only gates failed: v2 had 2/8 positive episodes; v3 had 4/8 positives from 1/2 task identities
route_decision.gpt_opsd_fallback: eligible by the preregistered trigger; CPU-only gateway route is implemented, but no endpoint, credential, model contract, or provider receipt is present
route_decision.candidate_open_evo_route: freeze only after selecting an auditable OpenEvo implementation and adapter artifact; do not silently reuse a failed or missing artifact

arms.OPEN_EVO: one frozen OpenEvo route with exact code/core/runtime/model/adapter identity
arms.SEED: one frozen SEED implementation with exact public source or auditable artifact identity
arms.BASE_CONTROL: optional frozen Qwen2.5-3B no-adapter control, only if both method arms use the same base model

frozen_comparison_contract.task_manifest: one newly materialized manifest, identical task identity and order for every arm
frozen_comparison_contract.invalid_attempt_policy: retain and report parser/runtime/identity failures; exclude them from valid-score denominators

manifest_probe.rejection_reason: The existing qualification generator emits temperature=0.4, max_steps=15, and rollout_seeds=[202600,202601]; H1.30 requires temperature=0.0, max_steps=30, and four preregistered rollout seeds. It is retained as a probe only, not as a formal task manifest.

reuse_requires: fresh H1.30 load/reload digest receipt (pass; receipt retained for audit)
jointly executable SEED route under the same evaluator contract

remaining_authorization: explicit freeze of the cross-campaign OpenEvo adapter or a newly trained H1.30 OpenEvo artifact
scientifically matched SEED training data and compute contract; current placeholder/random-goal qualification is not sufficient

training_manifest.overlay_cpu_reset_and_trainer_dry_run: manifest-bound-overlay-contract-pass; persistent-checkpoint-write-reload-pass; formal task consumption disabled
training_manifest.panel: fresh 16 train identities plus 8 validation identities, disjoint from the fresh 8-task evaluation panel
training_manifest.remaining_gate: resolve the failed v3 capability gate or authorize the separately audited teacher route, then freeze method-independent training, compute, and artifact contracts; formal GPU consumption remains disabled

planned_matrix.parallel_policy: one UUID-bound child container per GPU; use all eight only after every launch gate passes

speed: median valid episode wall time seconds
metrics.candidate_win_rule: OpenEvo may be called a candidate winner only with positive paired difference on at least one prespecified metric, method identity receipts, and no hidden invalid-rate degradation
metrics.claim_rule: A paper-level claim requires independent confirmation or uncertainty analysis

mandatory_launch_gates: SEED source/revision, runtime, model and evaluator are present and auditable; otherwise stop as non-comparable
OpenEvo route and adapter artifact have exact hashes and a reproducible load check
public manifest hash, task split, seeds, prompt/action/evaluator contracts are frozen before formal consumption
CPU pytest/unittest/preflight and remote online W&B probe are green; offline fallback requires an exact receipt
persistent checkpoint/storage capacity is proven by an exact write/reload receipt
all eight GPU UUIDs are idle and post-run release is verified
current_blocker: The fresh v3 panel is disjoint and its manifest-bound SEED input contract passes, but the v3 train-only capability gate produced 4 qualified positive episodes from 1 task identity versus the preregistered minimum of 8 episodes from 2 task identities. The OpenEvo artifact is still a cross-campaign H1.29 candidate, storage remains tight, and no H1.30 evaluation task or formal method arm is authorized.
claim_boundary: This draft does not claim OpenEvo superiority, SEED superiority, Q3, GPT/OPSD effectiveness, or a WebShop benchmark result.
